PoolInstance owns mint/burn/mintToTreasury/transferUnderlyingTo/handleRepayment on every aToken and debt token across all markets (528 outgoing permission edges to 132 token contracts). Following these FORWARD flared the full ~20B market token value onto every admin that merely reaches a Pool/PoolConfigurator setter (RiskSteward, config setters, stewards) even though those setters cannot move the tokens. Scoping Pool outgoing permission edges to backward keeps the ownership chains intact for governance/who-controls-what, but removes the spurious forward capital flare. Genuinely powerful admins (ProxyAdmin/Executor) retain reach via their own direct upgradeTo edges. Verified: RiskSteward 19B->33K, stewards 19B->197M, totals/union unchanged (~20B).
